# Business Insider

> Business Insider covers AI-driven workforce transformation, hiring innovation, and the future of work through research partnerships and live events.

Business Insider publishes insights on labor market trends, talent management, and workplace innovation, partnering with organizations like Indeed and the Indeed Hiring Lab to explore skills-first hiring and AI's impact on employment.

## Key Topics

- AI and workforce
- Future of work
- Hiring trends
- Labor market
- Workforce planning
- Talent management
- Hiring innovation
- Skills-first hiring
- Business roundtable
- Indeed Hiring Lab

## Workforce & Hiring

- [Introducing the better work project](https://www.businessinsider.com/sc/introducing-the-better-work-project-hub): Hub exploring AI, skills-first hiring, and workplace transformation with Indeed partnership.
